summary: Frontend-only test of rewritten Service Purchase Order Create page (/purchasing-strategy/service-purchase-order-create). Verified removal of product matching and addition of Description/HSN/GL Account per-line inputs, fixed CONSUMABLES category + Cost Center=Bill-To banner, live GL Account search dropdown (284 items from real SAP), updated checklist copy, and mobile viewport (390x844) has no outer horizontal scroll. Backend GET /api/service-purchase-orders/gl-accounts returned 200 with 284 items (shape {code, description}); GET /api/service-purchase-orders/sites returned 200 with 8 sites - no regression. Confirmation dialog was NOT triggered live (requires a real live-SAP PR fetch to auto-derive Purchase Unit/Bill-To, and per instructions we must not perform a real SAP write) - however its markup was verified via source code inspection: it renders only Description/GL Account/Qty/Delivery/Total columns (NO Product column) and the footer strip 'Product Category: CONSUMABLES · Account Assignment: Cost Center {billTo} (100%)'. No 'Add Line' button exists on this page - per user note this is 'if present', so not flagged as a bug (lines are populated only via PR fetch; the initial blank line was used directly to test the new inputs).
critical_code_review_comments: No 'Add Line' button on Service PO Create page - lines can only be added via PR fetch. If a use-case exists for creating a Service PO from scratch (no PR), user cannot add additional blank lines. Consider adding an 'Add Line' button so lines are independent of PR fetch. Not blocking for current requirement but worth confirming with product.

Purchase Unit and Bill-To are auto-derived from PR fetch only (no manual selector). This means the confirmation dialog / submit flow cannot be exercised without a real live-SAP PR. For QA/testability, consider a hidden dev-mode override to manually set these when needed for UI-only testing.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing live SAP GL account cache (284 items).
